Job Description: Title: Executive Assistant Company: Verda Location: Helsinki Region, Finland URL: https://fi.linkedin.com/jobs/view/executive-assistant-at-verda-4410812106 Posted: 2026-06-30 Deadline: N/A Reason: The job is located in Helsinki Region, which matches Manju's target criteria of being open to roles anywhere in Finland. ======================================== JOB DESCRIPTION: ======================================== LinkedIn kunnioittaa yksityisyyttäsi LinkedIn ja kolmannet osapuolet käyttävät välttämättömiä ja ei-välttämättömiä evästeitä palvelujemme tarjoamiseen, suojaamiseen, analysointiin ja parantamiseen sekä osuvien mainosten näyttämiseen sinulle (mukaan lukien ammattilais- ja työpaikkailmoitukset) LinkedInissä ja niiden ulkopuolella. Lisätietoja on evästekäytännössämme. Hyväksy ei-välttämättömien evästeiden käyttö valitsemalla Hyväksy tai estä niiden käyttö valitsemalla Hylkää. Voit päivittää valintasi milloin tahansa asetuksista. Hyväksy Hylkää Hyppää pääsisältöön LinkedIn Työt Poista teksti Poista teksti Kirjaudu sisään Liity nyt Executive Assistant Verda Helsinki 1 viikko sitten Yli 200 hakijaa Katso, kuka Verda on palkattu tähän rooliin Hae Tallenna Arvioi sopivuuttasi tekoälyn avulla Hanki tekoälypohjaisia neuvoja tähän työhön ja muita eksklusiivisia ominaisuuksia. Olenko sopiva tähän työhön? Räätälöi ansioluetteloni Imagine a future where everyone has instant, low-cost access to intelligence. We’re building a fully featured European AI cloud - with everything one needs to train, experiment with, and deploy AI models at scale. Our GPUs run on 100% renewable energy, powering a more sustainable AI ecosystem. We’re ambitious, curious, and gutsy doers. Low hierarchy, high ownership, and a big vision. After raising $64M in Series A, we’re only getting started. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. About The Role We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support up to three executives in a fast-paced environment. This role is critical to ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, effective time management, and strong coordination across internal and external stakeholders. The ideal candidate will be able to manage multiple priorities with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment, while helping executives stay focused on the highest-impact work. Your Responsibilities Manage and optimize complex calendars for up to three executives, including prioritization of key meetings, alignment with business objectives, and resolution of scheduling conflicts. Coordinate meetings end-to-end, including scheduling, agenda preparation, compilation of briefing materials, and follow-up on action items to support effective decision-making. Assist with inbox management by monitoring communications, drafting responses, flagging urgent matters, and helping ensure timely follow-up as needed. Arrange travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries, and expense tracking. Maintain accurate and well-organized documentation, records, and meeting notes as needed. Track action items and deadlines across executive meetings and projects, ensuring timely follow-through. Proactively identify and implement improvements to administrative workflows, communication practices, and team coordination. Act as a reliable point of contact and coordination for executives, internal teams, and external stakeholders where appropriate. Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism. Your key competencies Proven experience in an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, or similar support role. Experience supporting multiple senior leaders or executives simultaneously is strongly preferred. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong English skills, additional languages are a positive. High level of professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow through consistently. Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and solve problems proactively. Proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools, including email, calendar, document, and meeting platforms. Preferred Attributes Calm, adaptable, and resourceful under pressure. Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working style. Comfortable navigating changing priorities and ambiguity. Committed to accuracy, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Why Verda Cash + equity compensation along with various fringe benefits (e.g., healthcare, lunch, wellbeing, etc.). Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth. 31 nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. An opportunity to make a clear impact and work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. A community-like atmosphere: we often enjoy each other’s company after work, e.g., munching on BBQ made by Ruben, our CEO by day and master chef by night. Practicalities Location: Helsinki Working mode: On-site. Start date: Immediate start is available Employment type: Full-time and permanent What's Next Apply sooner than later. This job ad will be removed when we’ve found the right person. Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don’t accept applications sent by mail. paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Executive Assistant position within Verda's team. The opportunity to work across international contract law, IP, and privacy law at a globally recognised company is exactly the kind of environment I have been working towards – and I am confident my background makes me a strong fit.

I hold an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and have practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in a corporate legal practice. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5–7 commercial agreements per month – NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts – while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. More recently, I completed a professional language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu, where I worked directly within a Finnish law firm environment, developing my Finnish legal vocabulary and observing local legal processes first-hand.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

Verda's in-house model – working directly alongside the General Counsel and gaining exposure to corporate-level legal operations – is precisely the learning environment I am seeking. I am available for the September 2026 start and can commit to the part-time schedule during the academic year, transitioning to full-time over summer.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
